description: This file defines a theme configuration module for an Ocean-themed UI, providing functions to retrieve theme tokens and categorical color palettes tailored for consistent styling across a frontend application.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation details for the Ocean theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Produces a deterministic palette of colors for categorical data series, seeding from Ocean theme colors and extending as needed.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps a list of category names to specific colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
